description:
## 2.5.2-dev.0

- docs: swipe up reverts through the decoder, not the undo stack
- feat(swipe-up): revert the last autocorrection through Gboard's decoder
- refactor(patches): resolve branch targets in one shared helper
- chore: store gradlew.bat with LF, as .gitattributes declares
- chore(deps): bump gradle-wrapper from 9.7.1 to 9.8.0
- chore(deps): bump actions/upload-artifact from 4 to 7
- chore(deps): bump actions/setup-java from 6.0.0 to 6.0.1
